name: KBSP Spacer & Ad Blocks
author: biscuitbaby

sections.description:
KBSP Spacer & Ad Blocks lets you easily insert preset blank spaces (1 or 2 lines) and a single ad placeholder (banner1) into your posts and pages.
It works with both the Classic Editor and the Block Editor.

In the free version you can use the following:
* Blank spaces with 1 or 2 line presets.
* One ad placeholder block.

A Pro version offers additional features such as custom heights and multiple ad placeholders.
Pro version available at: https://biscuitbaby.gumroad.com/l/blankblockpro?wanted=true
sections.installation:
1. Go to “Plugins” → “Add New” → “Upload Plugin” and choose the ZIP file (kbsp-spacer-ad-blocks.zip).
  2. Click “Install Now” then activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
What is the difference between the free and Pro version?

The free version supports preset blank spaces (1 or 2 lines) and a single ad placeholder.
The Pro version offers custom height options and multiple ad placeholders.
